title: Emergency Medical Technicians
description: Assess injuries and illnesses and administer basic emergency medical care. May transport injured or sick persons to medical facilities.

tasks.text: Administer first aid treatment or life support care to sick or injured persons in prehospital settings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on emergency resuscitation and physical intervention

tasks.text: Assess nature and extent of illness or injury to establish and prioritize medical procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.text: Attend training classes to maintain certification licensure, keep abreast of new developments in the field, or maintain existing knowledge.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment
interpersonal — Rapport and emotional support require live human presence

dwas.name: Interact with patients to build rapport or provide emotional support.

tasks.text: Communicate with dispatchers or treatment center personnel to provide information about situation, to arrange reception of survivors, or to receive instructions for further treatment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Coordinate work with other emergency medical team members or police or fire department personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Decontaminate ambulance interior following treatment of patient with infectious disease, and report case to proper authorities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Loading and operating sterilizing equipment by hand

tasks.text: Drive mobile intensive care unit to specified location, following instructions from emergency medical dispatcher.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles to transport people/equipment

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport individuals or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Immobilize patient for placement on stretcher and ambulance transport, using backboard or other spinal immobilization device.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically positioning patients for exams

dwas.name: Position patients for treatment or examination.

tasks.text: Maintain vehicles and medical and communication equipment, and replenish first aid equipment and supplies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Medical supply inventory records and thresholds automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Observe, record, and report to physician the patient's condition or injury, the treatment provided, and reactions to drugs or treatment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform emergency diagnostic and treatment procedures, such as stomach suction, airway management, or heart monitoring, during ambulance ride.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on emergency resuscitation and physical intervention
